0991 What Network? If you’ve encountered a mobile number starting with 0991, you might be curious about which network it belongs to. Look no further! The 0991 prefix is owned by DITO Telecommunity, a relatively new but rapidly growing telecom provider in the Philippines.

0991 What Network?

When you come across a mobile number that begins with 0991, you can be sure it belongs to DITO Telecommunity. DITO Telecommunity is a newer telecom player in the Philippines, officially entering the market in March 2021. Despite being a relatively new entrant, DITO Telecommunity has quickly gained traction in the country by offering affordable mobile services and high-quality network coverage.

The 0991 prefix, like other prefixes, is used to identify the telecom provider of a number. DITO Telecommunity uses the 0991 prefix for mobile numbers that are registered under its network, whether for prepaid or postpaid services. If you’re using a 0991 number, you are a customer of DITO Telecommunity.

These prefixes help to distinguish DITO Telecommunity numbers from those issued by other telecom providers in the country.

Introduction to DITO Telecommunity

DITO Telecommunity is a telecommunications company that was officially launched in the Philippines in March 2021. As a new entrant into the telecom industry, DITO Telecommunity aims to challenge the dominance of the two major telecom players in the country, Globe Telecom and Smart Communications. The company is a joint venture between Chelsea Logistics Holdings Corp., Udenna Corporation, and the China Telecommunications Corporation.

DITO Telecommunity is dedicated to providing high-quality and affordable mobile services across the Philippines, including mobile broadband, voice services, and text services. The company has been investing heavily in infrastructure to build a nationwide network that delivers fast and reliable mobile connectivity, particularly in areas that were previously underserved by the two dominant players.

Despite its relatively short time in the market, DITO Telecommunity has made a significant impact by offering competitive pricing and an extensive 4G and 5G network that rivals the existing telecom providers. The company also emphasizes innovation, aiming to introduce new and advanced services that cater to the modern mobile user.

What Services Does DITO Telecommunity Offer?

DITO Telecommunity provides a broad range of services that cater to various mobile user needs. As a growing telecom provider, it offers both traditional mobile services and more advanced digital solutions. Here is a breakdown of the main services offered by DITO Telecommunity:

1. Prepaid Mobile Services

DITO Telecommunity is best known for its prepaid mobile services, which are ideal for customers who want flexibility and control over their mobile spending. Prepaid services allow users to pay only for the services they use, making it a more affordable option for budget-conscious consumers.

Prepaid Load: DITO Telecommunity allows customers to easily load their accounts using retail outlets, online platforms, or through its mobile app. Users can choose the amount of load they want to purchase, making it easier to manage their mobile usage without worrying about unexpected charges.

Voice and Text Plans: DITO Telecommunity offers affordable voice and text plans that allow customers to make calls and send text messages to any network at competitive rates. The company also provides unlimited options for calls and texts within the DITO network, which can help customers save even more on their communication expenses.

2. Data Plans

As mobile internet becomes increasingly important, DITO Telecommunity offers a wide range of data plans to meet the growing demand for mobile connectivity. Whether you’re browsing the web, watching videos, or using social media, DITO provides flexible data packages to suit different usage levels.

Data Packs: DITO Telecommunity offers various data packages that allow users to enjoy internet access for browsing, social media, and streaming. These data packs come with different data allowances, allowing customers to choose the plan that fits their needs. Whether you’re a light user who just needs access to messaging apps or a heavy user who needs more data for video streaming, DITO Telecommunity has a suitable option.

Mobile Broadband: For users who require more advanced internet services, DITO Telecommunity provides mobile broadband plans that allow customers to access high-speed internet via their mobile phones or portable Wi-Fi devices. The mobile broadband service can support various activities like streaming, gaming, and working remotely.

3. 5G Network

DITO Telecommunity is one of the few telecom providers in the Philippines to offer 5G services, making it a major player in the race for faster mobile internet speeds. With the rollout of 5G technology, DITO aims to provide ultra-fast mobile data services that will revolutionize the way Filipinos use their smartphones and other mobile devices.

5G speeds allow for faster downloads, lower latency, and smoother streaming, which is especially beneficial for activities like high-definition video calls, live streaming, and mobile gaming. DITO Telecommunity is actively expanding its 5G network to provide nationwide coverage, ensuring that customers can enjoy the benefits of next-generation mobile technology.

4. International Roaming

For customers who travel frequently, DITO Telecommunity offers international roaming services. This service allows you to stay connected even when you are abroad, enabling you to make calls, send messages, and use data in many countries around the world.

International roaming services are available for both prepaid and postpaid customers. DITO Telecommunity offers affordable roaming rates, so users don’t have to worry about expensive bills while traveling. It’s a great feature for those who need to stay in touch with family, friends, or work during their travels.

5. Postpaid Services

While DITO Telecommunity is known for its prepaid services, the company also provides postpaid plans for users who prefer a fixed monthly payment structure. These plans are ideal for individuals who need more data, talk time, and text messaging services without having to worry about reloading their accounts every month.

The postpaid plans come with various benefits, such as unlimited calls and texts within the DITO network, large data allocations, and a variety of bundled services. DITO Telecommunity also offers postpaid users the ability to choose flexible contracts that fit their needs.

How to Register with DITO Telecommunity

Getting started with DITO Telecommunity is simple. Whether you want to sign up for prepaid or postpaid services, the registration process is straightforward. Here’s how you can register:

1. Prepaid Registration
Purchase a DITO SIM card: You can buy a DITO Telecommunity SIM card at any authorized retailer or directly from DITO stores.

Activate your SIM card: Follow the activation instructions included with your SIM card. Activation can typically be done by inserting the SIM card into your phone and following the setup prompts.

Top-up your account: After activation, you can load your DITO account using retail outlets, the DITO app, or online platforms.

2. Postpaid Registration
Visit a DITO store: To sign up for a postpaid plan, you’ll need to visit a DITO Telecommunity store and provide identification documents.

Choose a plan: Based on your needs, you can select a DITO postpaid plan that fits your data, voice, and text requirements.

Features of DITO Telecommunity

Here are some of the key features that make DITO Telecommunity stand out in the competitive Philippine telecom market:

Affordable Pricing: DITO Telecommunity offers competitive pricing on both prepaid and postpaid plans, ensuring that mobile connectivity is affordable for all.

Fast and Reliable 5G: DITO Telecommunity is one of the first telecom providers in the Philippines to roll out 5G technology, ensuring fast data speeds and low latency for its users.

Wide Network Coverage: Despite being a new player in the market, DITO Telecommunity has been expanding its network coverage rapidly, offering reliable mobile services across the country.

Innovative Services: DITO Telecommunity is committed to introducing new and innovative services that enhance the overall mobile experience for its users.

How to Check the Network of Any Prefix

If you come across a mobile number and want to know which network it belongs to, there are several ways you can check:

Online Tools: There are many websites that provide tools to help you identify the network for a specific mobile number by entering the prefix.

Mobile Apps: Some mobile apps allow you to check the network affiliation of a mobile number.

Manual Lookup: If you are familiar with common mobile prefixes for different telecom providers, you can manually check the first few digits of the number. For example, numbers starting with 0991 belong to DITO Telecommunity.

Conclusion

If your mobile number starts with 0991, it belongs to DITO Telecommunity, a growing telecom provider in the Philippines. Offering affordable mobile plans, fast 5G speeds, and innovative services, DITO Telecommunity is quickly becoming a viable alternative to the traditional telecom giants in the country. Whether you’re looking for prepaid or postpaid plans, data services, or international roaming, DITO Telecommunity has something to offer for every type of mobile user.
